description: This file contains FastAPI route definitions and handlers related to payment processing in a food delivery platform. It includes endpoints for creating payment intents, updating payment statuses, and listing payment records, with access control and database interactions.

methods.name: None _assert_order_access(session: AsyncSession, user: AuthUser, order_id: UUID)
methods.description: Checks if the user has access to the specified order based on their role and relationship to the order.

methods.name: PaymentRecordOut create_payment_intent( payload: CreatePaymentIntentRequest, user: AuthUser = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Creates a mock payment intent and records it in the database, returning the payment record.

methods.name: PaymentRecordOut update_payment_status( payment_id: UUID, payload: UpdatePaymentStatusRequest, user: AuthUser = Depends(require_roles("admin")), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Allows an admin to update the status of a payment record, and marks the associated order as paid if succeeded.

methods.name: List[PaymentRecordOut] list_payments_for_order( order_id: UUID, user: AuthUser = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Returns a list of payment records associated with a specific order, with access control.

ctags.name: _assert_order_access
ctags.pattern: /^async def _assert_order_access(session: AsyncSession, user: AuthUser, order_id: UUID) -> None:$/

ctags.signature: ( payload: CreatePaymentIntentRequest, user: AuthUser = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )

ctags.name: list_payments_for_order
ctags.signature: ( order_id: UUID, user: AuthUser = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
